messages:
Maya (People Ops): FYI: consolidated schedule posted for the mid-year performance cycle. Key dates: self-evals due 2026-05-14 23:59 PT, manager summaries due 2026-05-21, calibration panels 2026-05-25 to 05-27, final ratings locked 2026-05-29. Please read the prep guide before panels: https://go/redwood/midyear-2026 :sparkles:

Ravi (People Ops): New process notes this cycle:
- Managers must upload anonymized evidence bullets (max 3) with each summary.
- Managers must hold a 1:1 within 3 business days after final ratings to discuss outcomes and development plans.
- Extension requests (leave/travel) via https://go/redwood/ext-request; People Ops responds within 48 hrs.

Hannah (Eng Manager): Can you share a quick paste-able invite blurb for panelists? Makes scheduling easier.

Maya (People Ops): Sure — paste this: 
"Subject: Calibration Panel Invite — [Team]
Please review anonymized pre-reads before the meeting. Bring 2 concise talking points per person (impact, development). We'll timebox to 12 minutes per review. Anchors: https://go/redwood/midyear-2026"

Luis (IC): If someone is on parental leave, do we automatically exclude them from the cycle or offer a deferred review?

Ravi (People Ops): We offer a deferral option. Managers submit deferral requests with proposed new deadlines; People Ops approves within 48 hrs. Max auto-approval deferral is 21 days; longer needs leadership sign-off.

CompBot: Reminder: Do not include comp recommendations in initial manager summaries. Compensation is handled in the post-calibration compensation worksheet.

Hannah (Eng Manager): How should we format anonymized evidence? Examples would help.

Maya (People Ops): Keep it neutral and concrete, 1 line each, e.g.:
- "Reduced end-to-end sync latency by 35% for feature Z (measured in prod traces)."
- "Led cross-team incident response; authored postmortem and mitigation plan."
Avoid names/team identifiers.

Luis (IC): Is there an appeals window after ratings are posted?

Ravi (People Ops): Yes — employees have 10 business days to submit an appeal with new evidence or procedural concerns. People Ops triages and escalates to the Calibration Chair as needed.

Maya (People Ops): Last admin note: if your panel needs timezone accommodation, flag cases in the RSVP sheet so we can allocate an asynchronous slot and accept a short manager voice memo as supplemental context. Thanks!
